tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures support sink-inhibited forcing with coupled memory. The pilot already brackets the target horizon of 0.46, but its five endpoints span only H = 0.38–0.52. Finer trajectory observations can distinguish how quickly the memory contribution changes from how strongly it affects the forecast.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a five-parameter coupled siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations near the same horizon provide little leverage to separate the memory relaxation time from the coupling strength and sink inhibition.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static sink-inhibited siphon model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It accounts for the sink gradient but omits the observed coupled transient lag.
It does not resolve the transient or distinguish memory coupling from sink inhibition.
